description: This PHP class 'IconFinder' is part of Drupal's core theme icon system. It locates icon files based on specified sources, supporting local paths with pattern placeholders for icon ID and group, as well as direct URLs. It uses Symfony Finder for filesystem searches and handles URL parsing, filename extraction, and metadata collection for icons.

classes.name: IconFinder
classes.description: A class for discovering icon files in local directories or URLs, supporting pattern-based extraction of icon IDs and groups, with integration into Drupal's dependency injection system.

methods.name: getFileContents
methods.description: Reads the contents of a file if it exists locally and is not a URL.

methods.name: getFilesFromSources
methods.description: Retrieves icon files from a list of sources, handling both URLs and local paths.

methods.name: getFileFromUrl
methods.description: Extracts icon information from a URL source, validating protocols.

methods.name: getFilesFromPath
methods.description: Uses Symfony Finder to locate icon files in a local directory, supporting pattern placeholders.

methods.name: findFiles
methods.description: Creates and configures a Symfony Finder instance to search for files.

methods.name: processFoundFiles
methods.description: Processes files found by Symfony Finder, extracting icon IDs and metadata.

methods.name: extractIconIdFromFilename
methods.description: Extracts icon ID from filename based on pattern.

methods.name: extractGroupFromPath
methods.description: Extracts group metadata from a file path based on position.

methods.name: determineGroupPosition
methods.description: Determines the position of the group placeholder in a source path.

search-terms: URL and local path icon discovery
